title: Calibration algorithm for hybrid solar-blind ultraviolet detectors for discharge detection of high-voltage electrical equipment
content:
by Shideng Zhu, Chuang Wang, Yuanjun Wang, Baolong Liu

The solar-blind ultraviolet technology mainly utilizes the “solar-blind” characteristics of the mid ultraviolet region for detection, which is usually not affected by sunlight interference. However, the ultraviolet spectrum has a wide range and may overlap with other spectra such as near ultraviolet or visible light. The cross interference caused by spectral overlap reduces the accuracy of discharge detection for high-voltage electrical equipment. For this purpose, a hybrid solar-blind UV detector calibration algorithm was designed to optimize discharge detection results and improve detection accuracy. The core innovation of this paper lies in the introduction of feature classification and color calibration into the signal post-processing process of solar-blind ultraviolet detectors, solving the problem of spectral cross interference from the chromaticity dimension, breaking the limitations of traditional methods that only rely on optical filtering and single threshold judgment, simultaneously improving detection sensitivity (96.3%) and signal-to-noise ratio (18.6 dB), and providing an engineering mixed detection calibration scheme for discharge detection of high-voltage electrical equipment. After analyzing the frequency characteristics of discharge signals based on solar-blind technology, high-voltage electrical equipment brightness detection is achieved through ultraviolet detection technology; Subsequently, on the basis of hybrid solar-blind ultraviolet detection, the discharge detection process is completed by using signal similarity calculation and chaotic system based discharge detection output. In order to solve the possible cross interference problem, feature classification and color calibration are introduced, and a hybrid solar-blind ultraviolet detection calibration algorithm is designed to further improve the accuracy and reliability of discharge detection. The experimental structure shows that the proposed algorithm has achieved significant results in overcoming cross interference and enhancing detection accuracy, providing a reference for further research in the field of high-voltage electrical equipment discharge detection.
author: Shideng Zhu
